name: Jellyfin
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Jellyfin is a media server for your own films, shows, music and photos, streamed to its web app and apps for phones and TVs. The egg installs it with jellyfin-ffmpeg for transcoding on the CPU and finishes its setup on the first start with an admin account and a random password.
startup: [ -f .raptor-setup-done ] || bash .raptor-first-start.sh {{SERVER_PORT}} || exit 1; exec ./jellyfin/jellyfin --datadir data --configdir config --cachedir cache --logdir log --webdir jellyfin/jellyfin-web --ffmpeg jellyfin-ffmpeg/ffmpeg

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Jellyfin: downloads Jellyfin's portable build and the jellyfin-ffmpeg it
# needs from repo.jellyfin.org, each checked against the checksum the
# repository publishes. Settings (config/), the database and metadata
# (data/) and media are never touched; jellyfin/ and jellyfin-ffmpeg/ are
# only replaced once the new ones have downloaded and checked out.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

repo=https://repo.jellyfin.org/files
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
offline="Jellyfin's download site can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again in a few minutes."
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ffarch=linux64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ffarch=linuxarm64 ;;
    *) fail "Jellyfin has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac
# list <dir>: the file and folder names in one of the repository's folders.
list() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 "$repo/$1/" | sed -n 's/.*<a href="\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | grep -v '^\.\./$'; }
# fetch <path> <file>: downloads it and checks it against the repository's checksum.
fetch() {
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$2" "$repo/$1" || fail "The download of ${1##*/} failed. Reinstall to try again."
    [ "$(sha256sum "$2" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(checksum "$1")" ] || fail "The download of ${1##*/} didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
}
checksum() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 "$repo/$1?sha256" | cut -d' ' -f1; }

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
want=${want#v}
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    file=$(list "server/linux/latest-stable/$arch" | grep -E "^jellyfin_[0-9.]+-$arch\.tar\.xz$" | sed -n 1p) || fail "$offline"
    version=${file#jellyfin_}; version=${version%-"$arch".tar.xz}
    path="server/linux/latest-stable/$arch/$file"
else
    version=$want
    file="jellyfin_$version-$arch.tar.xz"
    path="server/linux/stable/v$version/$arch/$file"
    if ! list "server/linux/stable/v$version/$arch" 2>/dev/null | grep -qxF "$file"; then
        have=$(list server/linux/stable) || fail "$offline"
        fail "Jellyfin has no version $want to download. Set Version to latest, or to one of: $(sed -n 's|^v\(.*\)/$|\1|p' <<<"$have" | sort -V | paste -sd ' ' -)"
    fi
fi

tmp=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$tmp" .raptor-old && mkdir -p "$tmp"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp" .raptor-old' EXIT
sum=$(checksum "$path") || fail "$offline"
if [ -x jellyfin/jellyfin ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-jellyfin 2>/dev/null)" = "$sum" ]; then
    echo "Jellyfin $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Jellyfin $version"
    fetch "$path" "$tmp/jellyfin.tar.xz"
    tar -xJf "$tmp/jellyfin.tar.xz" -C "$tmp"
    rm -f "$tmp/jellyfin.tar.xz"
    [ -x "$tmp/jellyfin/jellyfin" ] || fail "Jellyfin $version's download doesn't have the server in it. Choose another version."
    rm -rf .raptor-old
    [ ! -e jellyfin ] || mv jellyfin .raptor-old
    mv "$tmp/jellyfin" jellyfin
    echo "$sum" > .raptor-jellyfin
fi

# The jellyfin-ffmpeg major version this Jellyfin release depends on, from
# Jellyfin's Debian repository (7 for 10.x, 8 for 12.x when it isn't listed).
ffmajor=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://repo.jellyfin.org/debian/dists/trixie/main/binary-amd64/Packages 2>/dev/null |
    awk -v v="$version+deb13" '/^Package: /{p=($2=="jellyfin")} p&&/^Version: /{m=($2==v)} p&&m&&/^Depends: /{if (match($0, /jellyfin-ffmpeg[0-9]+/)) print substr($0, RSTART+15, RLENGTH-15); exit}') || true
[ -n "$ffmajor" ] || case "$version" in 10.*) ffmajor=7 ;; *) ffmajor=8 ;; esac
ffdir="ffmpeg/linux/latest-$ffmajor.x/$arch"
fffile=$(list "$ffdir" | grep -E "^jellyfin-ffmpeg_.*_portable_$ffarch-gpl\.tar\.xz$" | sed -n 1p) || fail "$offline"
ffsum=$(checksum "$ffdir/$fffile") || fail "$offline"
ffversion=${fffile#jellyfin-ffmpeg_}; ffversion=${ffversion%%_*}
if [ -x jellyfin-ffmpeg/ffmpeg ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-ffmpeg 2>/dev/null)" = "$ffsum" ]; then
    echo "jellyfin-ffmpeg $ffversion is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading jellyfin-ffmpeg $ffversion"
    fetch "$ffdir/$fffile" "$tmp/ffmpeg.tar.xz"
    mkdir -p "$tmp/ffmpeg"
    tar -xJf "$tmp/ffmpeg.tar.xz" -C "$tmp/ffmpeg"
    [ -x "$tmp/ffmpeg/ffmpeg" ] || fail "jellyfin-ffmpeg's download doesn't have ffmpeg in it. Reinstall to try again."
    rm -rf jellyfin-ffmpeg
    mv "$tmp/ffmpeg" jellyfin-ffmpeg
    echo "$ffsum" > .raptor-ffmpeg
fi
mkdir -p config data cache log media

# Jellyfin's own settings: no LAN auto-discovery (it can't work from a
# container), and the port, which the server's settings keep up to date.
if [ ! -f config/network.xml ]; then
    cat > config/network.xml <<'EOF'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<NetworkConfiguration xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">
  <AutoDiscovery>false</AutoDiscovery>
  <InternalHttpPort>8096</InternalHttpPort>
  <EnableRemoteAccess>true</EnableRemoteAccess>
</NetworkConfiguration>
EOF
fi

# A new Jellyfin lets whoever opens it first take the admin account in its
# setup wizard. The first start runs this before Jellyfin opens its port:
# it starts Jellyfin on a port only the server can reach and finishes the
# wizard with the admin account admin and a random password. (It can't run
# here: Jellyfin needs libraries the install container doesn't have.)
cat > .raptor-first-start.sh <<'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
# Raptor's egg: finishes Jellyfin's setup wizard once, on a private port.
set -uo pipefail
port=$1 private=18096 log=.raptor-first-start.log
net=config/network.xml
setport() { sed -i "s|<InternalHttpPort>[0-9]*</InternalHttpPort>|<InternalHttpPort>$1</InternalHttpPort>|" "$net"; }
setport "$private"
# A stop during the setup stops Jellyfin and puts the port back.
trap 'kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null; wait "$pid"; setport "$port"; exit 1' INT TERM
./jellyfin/jellyfin --datadir data --configdir config --cachedir cache --logdir log \
    --webdir jellyfin/jellyfin-web --ffmpeg jellyfin-ffmpeg/ffmpeg > "$log" 2>&1 &
pid=$!
echo "Finishing Jellyfin's setup (first start only)"
for _ in $(seq 300); do
    grep -qE "Startup complete|\[FTL\]" "$log" && break
    kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || break
    sleep 1
done
api="http://127.0.0.1:$private/Startup"
post() { curl -fsS -o /dev/null -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "$2" "$api/$1"; }
password=$(head -c 18 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -d '/+=')
ok=0
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$api/User")
if [ "$code" = 401 ] || [ "$code" = 403 ]; then
    ok=2 # set up already
elif [ "$code" = 200 ] &&
    post Configuration '{"UICulture": "en-US", "MetadataCountryCode": "US", "PreferredMetadataLanguage": "en"}' &&
    post User "{\"Name\": \"admin\", \"Password\": \"$password\"}" &&
    post RemoteAccess '{"EnableRemoteAccess": true}' &&
    curl -fsS -o /dev/null -X POST "$api/Complete"; then
    ok=1
fi
# (A job started in the background ignores SIGINT, so it's SIGTERM.)
kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null
wait "$pid"
trap - INT TERM
setport "$port"
if [ "$ok" = 0 ]; then
    tail -n 30 "$log"
    echo "Jellyfin couldn't finish its setup, so it isn't opened to the internet. Restart the server to try again."
    exit 1
fi
rm -f "$log"
touch .raptor-setup-done
[ "$ok" = 2 ] || echo "The admin account is admin, with the password $password. Change it in Jellyfin's dashboard."
SCRIPT
echo "Installed Jellyfin $version with jellyfin-ffmpeg $ffversion."
